title: Week 1: The Goose Who Would Be Mayor

cards.text: The Goose Union demands a pond. Inside City Hall. In your office. They've already measured your desk.

right.label: Build the pond
right.reaction: Honk! (Gratitude. Probably.)

left.label: No ponds indoors
left.reaction: The union will remember this. They have long memories and longer necks.

up.label: A pond in the park
up.reaction: A compromise. The geese are... considering it.

cards.text: The pond contractor is a goose. He's laid the foundations. And an egg. Work has stopped.

right.label: Pay him in bread
right.reaction: Work resumed. The egg is supervising.

left.label: Hire human builders
left.reaction: The geese are picketing the humans. The humans are scared.

cards.text: The pond is finished. It's in your office. It's lovely. Except the smell. And the smell's smell.

right.label: Grand opening!
right.reaction: Gerald cut the ribbon. With his face.

left.label: Quiet opening
left.reaction: The geese are hurt you didn't invite the press.

cards.text: The office pond is leaking. Into the records room. 1987 is underwater. 1988 is next.

right.label: Fix the leak
right.reaction: Dry again. 1987 will smell of pond forever.

left.label: Call it an indoor river
left.reaction: Tourists are kayaking through Planning.

cards.text: There is goose poop on every floor of City Hall. Every floor. Including the roof. How?

right.label: Hire cleaners
right.reaction: Clean! For about an hour.

left.label: It's good luck
left.reaction: Marge printed that. Now people want some.

cards.text: The indoor river has reached the library. The books are swimming. Some of them are winning.

right.label: Build a bridge
right.reaction: A bridge inside City Hall. It has a troll. The troll is Dave.

left.label: Sell rafting tickets
left.reaction: Rafting is up. Paperwork is down. Mostly in the river.

cards.text: The geese have had goslings. Forty of them. They'd like a second pond. For the children. Honk.

right.label: A second pond
right.reaction: HONK! (Gerald wept. Then bit Doug.)

left.label: One pond is plenty
left.reaction: The goslings are staging a sit-in. They're very small. It's very sad.

cards.text: The geese have occupied the car park. They have a flag. They have a list. The list is mostly 'pond'.

right.label: Fine, build the pond
right.reaction: Victory honk. The flag stays.

left.label: Send in Chief Barb
left.reaction: Barb versus geese. The geese are winning on points.

cards.text: We've lost the bakery. The geese have the bakery. They're making bread. For themselves.

right.label: Negotiate
right.reaction: Peace. The bread is shared. It's mostly crusts.

left.label: Starve them out
left.reaction: They have a bakery. You cannot starve a bakery.

cards.text: The geese have elected their own mayor. It's Gerald. His approval rating is higher than yours.

right.label: Debate Gerald
right.reaction: He honked for an hour. He won on volume.

left.label: Merge the towns
left.reaction: You're co-mayor with a goose. Honestly, it's going fine.

cards.text: The park pond is nice. But the geese say the park is 'outside'. They would like a roof. A big one.

right.label: Build a roof
right.reaction: A roof over a pond. Indoor-outdoor living. Honk.

left.label: Outside is fine
left.reaction: Gerald wrote an op-ed. It's mostly 'HONK'.

cards.text: Lovely town. How much for all of it? I'm asking for a friend. The friend is me.

right.label: Name a silly price
right.reaction: A billion and a goose. Interesting. I'll be back.

left.label: Throw him out
left.reaction: I've been thrown out of better towns. This one, actually.

up.label: Hear him out
up.reaction: A deposit. No strings. A few strings.

cards.text: About our deal. I'd like the clock tower. Just the clock. Not the tower. Or the time.

right.label: Give him the clock
right.reaction: Nobody knows what time it is. Productivity is way up.

left.label: Return his deposit
left.reaction: Pity. I'll be in touch. Through the basement.

cards.text: A note under your door: 'LOOK IN THE BASEMENT.' The handwriting is very neat. Suspiciously neat.

right.label: Go and look
right.reaction: Boxes. Hundreds. All labelled 'DO NOT COUNT'.

left.label: Burn the note
left.reaction: A second note arrived. It just says 'RUDE.'

cards.text: A third note. It was in your sandwich. 'BASEMENT. PLEASE.' The sandwich was otherwise fine.

right.label: Fine, go and look
right.reaction: Boxes. So many boxes.

left.label: Eat the sandwich
left.reaction: Delicious. Ominous. Delicious.

cards.text: The basement boxes are old ballots from the last election. Every single one says 'Gerald'.

right.label: Tell the town
right.reaction: So the goose won. And nobody said anything.

left.label: Put them back
left.reaction: You saw nothing. The boxes saw you.

cards.text: You found the ballots. I was the mayor before you. They voted for a goose instead. Help me, or expose me.

right.label: Expose him
right.reaction: Print it. I've been run out of better towns.

left.label: Take his hush money
left.reaction: Smart. Wrong, but smart.

cards.text: Technically, I am the mayor. Honk. I'd like my office back. I hear it has a pond now.

right.label: Share the office
right.reaction: Co-mayors. He sits on the desk. You sit near the desk.

left.label: Absolutely not
left.reaction: He's filed a lawsuit. In honk.

cards.text: Main Street has a pothole so big it has a name. The name is Kevin. Kevin got a jury summons.

right.label: Fill in Kevin
right.reaction: Goodbye, Kevin. You were expensive.

left.label: Leave Kevin alone
left.reaction: Kevin is growing. Kevin is thriving.

up.label: Sell tickets to Kevin
up.reaction: People are queuing. To look at a hole.

cards.text: Kevin swallowed a parked car. It was Chad's. Chad would like it back, or Kevin arrested.

right.label: Fish out the car
right.reaction: It smells of hole. Chad sold it to Kevin's fans.

left.label: Arrest Kevin
left.reaction: You arrested a hole. Marge has a front page for a week.

cards.text: Kevin is now a sinkhole. He ate the post office. Kevin is getting mail.

right.label: Fill it with concrete
right.reaction: Kevin is sealed. We can hear him sulking.

left.label: Kevin is an attraction
left.reaction: Two tourists fell in. They're fine. Kevin's fine.

cards.text: Good news: Kevin is filled. Bad news: Kevin Junior has appeared next door. He has his father's eyes.

right.label: Fill him too
right.reaction: Kevin Junior is gone. There are rumours of a Kevin the Third.

left.label: Let the boy grow
left.reaction: Kevin Junior has a fan club. It's Timmy.

cards.text: The Bugle needs a front page. Can we say you wrestled a bear? Not a big bear. A believable bear.

right.label: Yes, I wrestled a bear
right.reaction: Did you win? Never mind. You won.

left.label: Tell the truth
left.reaction: Honesty. On a Tuesday. Bold.

cards.text: A bear is in my office. It read the article. It says you two need to talk.

right.label: Apologise to the bear
right.reaction: The bear accepts. It would like a column.

left.label: Wrestle it for real
left.reaction: You lost. But we got photos.

cards.text: The bear's column is our most popular. It's mostly about honey. Now it wants to run for council.

right.label: Endorse the bear
right.reaction: The bear is on council. It sits on two chairs.

left.label: Bears can't run
left.reaction: The bear is suing. Its lawyer is also a bear.

cards.text: The bear wants a rematch. Live on Town TV. Everyone's betting. Mostly on the bear.

right.label: Accept the rematch
right.reaction: You lost again, bravely. Record ratings.

left.label: Hide in the cheese vault
left.reaction: The bear found you. It brought crackers.

cards.text: Put a casino in the library. Books are just slow slot machines. Think of the revenue. I have.

right.label: Build the casino
right.reaction: You won't regret this. Others will.

left.label: Refuse
left.reaction: Fine. Enjoy your free knowledge.

up.label: One casino night
up.reaction: One night. I'll make it count.

cards.text: Someone is counting cards at the library casino. It's the librarian. She's very good. Chad is crying.

right.label: Ban Linda
right.reaction: She moved to roulette. She's very good at that too.

left.label: Make her head of security
left.reaction: Nobody cheats now. She can smell it.

cards.text: The casino owes money. To Linda. It's the whole casino. She owns it now.

right.label: Let her keep it
right.reaction: The casino is a library again. With better odds.

left.label: Bail it out
left.reaction: Chad thanks you. Linda doesn't.

cards.text: Casino night made a fortune. Everyone wants another. Every night. Starting tonight.

right.label: Every night
right.reaction: The library never sleeps. The librarians are furious.

left.label: Once was enough
left.reaction: Chad is calling it 'a tragedy for culture'.

cards.text: Can we have a Frog Day? I already told everyone there's a Frog Day. Also the frogs. They're coming.

right.label: Frog Day!
right.reaction: FROG DAY! FROG DAY!

left.label: No Frog Day
left.reaction: I'm telling the frogs.

cards.text: Frog Day went well. The frogs have not left. They're in the fountain, the school, and my hat.

right.label: Frog round-up
right.reaction: Rounded up. Two escaped. They're in charge now.

left.label: Frogs are citizens now
left.reaction: The frogs registered to vote. Turnout is excellent.

cards.text: The frogs have endorsed a candidate for mayor. It's a bigger frog.

right.label: Court the frog vote
right.reaction: You ate a fly on camera. Frogs approve.

left.label: Frogs can't vote after all
left.reaction: Timmy is on hunger strike. He had a big breakfast first.

cards.text: The frogs came anyway. They're very disappointed. One of them is crying. It's me. I'm crying.

right.label: Fine, a small Frog Day
right.reaction: Small Frog Day! Small frogs!

left.label: Be strong
left.reaction: Marge photographed Timmy crying. Front page.

cards.text: We need a helicopter. For crime. And also, mostly, for fun. I've already bought the sunglasses.

right.label: Buy it
right.reaction: Front seat. Forever.

left.label: Lease one
left.reaction: A rental. I'm still doing the noises.

down.label: No helicopter
down.reaction: Fine. I'll run very fast with my arms out.

cards.text: The helicopter circles the school all day. The children can't hear the teacher. Grades are up, oddly.

right.label: Ground it in school hours
right.reaction: Barb is sulking in the hangar.

left.label: It's educational
left.reaction: The children are fluent in helicopter.

cards.text: The helicopter is stuck on the church spire. Barb is still in it. She says she lives there now.

right.label: Rescue Barb
right.reaction: Rescued. She's already planning a second helicopter.

left.label: Let her live there
left.reaction: She has a view. She's happy. Crime is unattended.

cards.text: I'm launching a rocket from the school field. My guy says it's safe. My guy says it goes 'mostly up'.

right.label: Clear the launch
right.reaction: Ten, nine, eight...

left.label: No rockets near children
left.reaction: Fine. I'll launch something quieter. And bigger.

cards.text: Chad's rocket went up. It's coming down. My forecast: the library. Or the moon. Probably the library.

right.label: Evacuate the library
right.reaction: Everyone's out. Linda refused. She's fine. Of course she is.

left.label: It'll miss
left.reaction: It did not miss.

cards.text: The rocket landed on the library. The top floor's books are in orbit. Returns are due Friday.

right.label: Rebuild the library
right.reaction: Reopened. In case the books come back.

left.label: Leave the rocket in
left.reaction: It's the reading rocket now. Story time has a countdown.

cards.text: The town needs a mascot. Our readers voted. They chose 'Wet Sock'.

right.label: Welcome, Wet Sock
right.reaction: He's damp. He's proud. He's ours.

left.label: Hire a designer
left.reaction: It's a smiling building. Readers call it 'Dry Sock'.

cards.text: Wet Sock merchandise is selling out. I want a cut. Also a sock. A wet one.

right.label: Give Chad a cut
right.reaction: Damp profits.

left.label: Free socks for the people
left.reaction: Free wet socks for all. Nobody asked for this.

cards.text: Wet Sock dried out in the sun. The children are inconsolable. He's just a sock now.

right.label: Re-wet the sock
right.reaction: He's back. Damper than ever.

left.label: Let him go
left.reaction: A state funeral for a sock. Marge wept.

cards.text: Boss. Small favour. Can I... we... get a pay rise? In bin bags. Not money. Bin bags.

right.label: Bin bags it is
right.reaction: Thank you. Best day of our... my life.

left.label: No
left.reaction: Understood. We'll be in the bins. Sulking.

cards.text: Dave's 'cousins' have moved into City Hall. All of them. They're raccoons. Dave says they're 'consultants'.

right.label: Hire the consultants
right.reaction: Productivity is up. The bins are down.

left.label: Evict them
left.reaction: They left. Dave cried. Three times. Simultaneously.

cards.text: A pigeon has been signing papers at your desk for a week. I checked. Some of it is very good policy.

right.label: Hire the pigeon
right.reaction: It wants an office. The office must have a ledge.

left.label: Evict the pigeon
left.reaction: It left. It took your stapler. It knew which one was yours.

cards.text: The pigeon now has a press secretary. Also a pigeon. They've announced a policy on bread.

right.label: Back the bread policy
right.reaction: Bread for everyone. Mostly crumbs.

left.label: Clip its wings, politically
left.reaction: The pigeon resigned. In a single, dignified coo.

cards.text: Teens are standing near the fountain. Just standing. One of them is leaning. I want a curfew.

right.label: Curfew at 9 pm
right.reaction: Order. Beautiful, quiet order.

left.label: Let them stand
left.reaction: Then I'm standing near them. Menacingly.

up.label: Fund a youth centre
up.reaction: Now they stand indoors. I'll allow it.

cards.text: I'd like a tiny tax break. You'd need a telescope to see it. I own the telescope shop.

right.label: Grant it
right.reaction: A pleasure doing business with the public.

left.label: Refuse
left.reaction: I'll remember this at the country club.

cards.text: School lunch is beige. All of it. Yesterday the beige was seen leaving the kitchen on its own.

right.label: Pay for real food
right.reaction: A vegetable! Some of them cried.

left.label: Chad sponsors lunch
left.reaction: 'Chad Nuggets.' The Bugle is having a field day.

down.label: Beige builds character
down.reaction: The PTA has a long memory.

cards.text: The station needs a police dog. We have one. Sergeant Biscuit. He is afraid of crime, cats, and Tuesdays.

right.label: Buy a braver dog
right.reaction: This one bit me. Perfect.

left.label: Therapy for Biscuit
left.reaction: He's talking about his feelings. Barking, really.

cards.text: The town's mimes are on strike. Nobody can tell. They'd like you to notice. They're pointing at you. Hard.

right.label: Notice them loudly
right.reaction: They're thrilled. One is trapped in a box about it.

left.label: Ignore the mimes
left.reaction: They're booing. Silently. It's somehow worse.

cards.text: We could put parking meters on Main Street. People will hate it. The budget will weep with joy.

right.label: Install meters
right.reaction: Coins. Lovely, countable coins.

left.label: Free parking forever
left.reaction: Forever is a long time for a budget.

cards.text: The town's emergency fund is four tons of cheese stored since 1987. I went to count it. It counted me back.

right.label: Sell the cheese
right.reaction: Sold. Don't make eye contact with it.

left.label: Cheese festival
left.reaction: Nine thousand people. One cheese. No survivors. Of the cheese.

up.label: Seal the vault
up.reaction: Sealed. It's knocking. Politely, so far.

cards.text: I've filed the paperwork. The town now legally owns the moon. We just need a flag. And a very long pole.

right.label: Plant the flag
right.reaction: It's ours. Don't look at it without a permit.

left.label: Sell the moon to Chad
left.reaction: He renamed it 'Chad's Night Light'.

cards.text: We've been twinned with a town called Worse Town. They're visiting today. They already look disappointed.

right.label: Throw a welcome party
right.reaction: They loved it. They've asked to be adopted.

left.label: Show them the pothole
left.reaction: Their mayor wept. 'It's bigger than ours,' he said.

cards.text: The school has one textbook. It's about boats. We are four hundred miles from water.

right.label: Buy new books
right.reaction: The PTA approves. We've never said that before.

left.label: Buy a boat
left.reaction: The children can all tie knots now. They're thriving.

down.label: Boats are educational
down.reaction: The PTA has started a newsletter. About you.

cards.text: I'm giving the town a statue. Of me. Forty feet tall. It winks. At noon it says 'You're welcome'.

right.label: Accept the statue
right.reaction: It winks at night too. You'll get used to it.

left.label: No statues
left.reaction: I'll put it just outside town. Facing in.

cards.text: It's my birthday. Can the whole town have fireworks? I told the whole town yes. I'm eight. I'm in charge.

right.label: Fireworks for Timmy
right.reaction: BEST. MAYOR. EVER.

left.label: One sparkler
left.reaction: It's... one. It's a small one.

cards.text: I need a weather radar. Right now I lick my finger and hold it up. My finger is tired. It's seen things.

right.label: Buy the radar
right.reaction: I can see rain coming! It's already raining.

left.label: The finger is fine
left.reaction: Tomorrow will be... weather.

cards.text: A wizard has moved into the clock tower. Every hour, instead of chiming, it says 'Ooooh'. He pays rent in sparkles.

right.label: Evict the wizard
right.reaction: He left. The clock still says 'Ooooh'.

left.label: Make him town magician
left.reaction: He turned the bins into doves. The doves are bins now.

cards.text: The bus route has become a circle. It's gone round for a week. The passengers have formed a government.

right.label: Add a stop
right.reaction: They got off. Some of them got back on. They miss it.

left.label: Recognise their government
left.reaction: They've declared independence. Seat 14 is the capital.

cards.text: The Bugle wants karaoke night at City Hall. You'd sing first. You'd sing 'the hard one'.

right.label: Sing the hard one
right.reaction: Your high note broke a window. Front page.

left.label: No singing in City Hall
left.reaction: The silence is deafening. Marge is writing about it.

cards.text: Someone painted a zebra crossing. With a real zebra. It won't move. Traffic has stopped. The zebra seems content.

right.label: Hire a zebra wrangler
right.reaction: Moved. It's on the roundabout now. Content.

left.label: Make it official
left.reaction: Everyone crosses by the zebra. It nods at them.

cards.text: Every traffic light went green at once. Nobody's crashed. Everyone is being polite. Nobody can leave.

right.label: Fix the lights
right.reaction: Red, amber, green. The town wept with relief.

left.label: Leave them green
left.reaction: Society has entered a politeness spiral. It's beautiful.

cards.text: Your official portrait is done. The artist painted you as a bear. A good bear. A dignified bear.

right.label: Hang it proudly
right.reaction: The bear looks over City Hall. People salute it.

left.label: Pay for a repaint
left.reaction: Now you're a smaller bear. Progress.

cards.text: The dog show needs a judge. All forty dogs are Sergeant Biscuit. Barb says that's 'not possible'.

right.label: Every dog wins
right.reaction: Forty rosettes. All Biscuit. He's unbearable now.

left.label: Find the real Biscuit
left.reaction: Found him. The other thirty-nine were raccoons.

cards.text: The town marathon is today. Nobody trained. The route goes through the bakery. Twice.

right.label: Run it yourself
right.reaction: You finished. You ate a pie. Nobody's counting.

left.label: Postpone it
left.reaction: Postponed. Three people are still running.

cards.text: I want to turn the old fire station into an arcade. The fire engine is a ride now. It still has water in it.

right.label: Open the arcade
right.reaction: First ride soaked the deputy mayor. Fun for all.

left.label: Firefighters only
left.reaction: The firefighters have the high score. Of course.

cards.text: I'd like to pave the park. For parking. Think of it as a very flat park.

right.label: Pave the park
right.reaction: Smell that? Asphalt. Progress.

left.label: Hands off the park
left.reaction: Trees don't shop, you know.

cards.text: The Bugle is staging an opera about you. Four hours. You die in act one. The rest is the funeral.

right.label: Attend and applaud
right.reaction: You cried at your own funeral. That's tomorrow's photo.

left.label: Ban the opera
left.reaction: Banned. So now it's a musical. A longer one.

cards.text: A heatwave is coming. Or a cold snap. It's one of those. Either way, the pool is cracked.

right.label: Fix the pool
right.reaction: It's snowing. But the pool looks great.

left.label: Tell people to drink water
left.reaction: Hot, with a chance of angry.

cards.text: I gave some squirrels a loan. I was very tired. They put up acorns as collateral. They've defaulted.

right.label: Repossess the acorns
right.reaction: We own nine hundred acorns. The squirrels are watching.

left.label: Forgive the loan
left.reaction: They chittered. One saluted.

cards.text: There's a monster in the reservoir. It's very shy. I only know because it returned my umbrella.

right.label: Put it on the brochure
right.reaction: Tourists everywhere. The monster sent a note: 'please stop'.

left.label: Protect its privacy
left.reaction: It left a fish on your doorstep. You're friends now.

cards.text: Someone stole the 'Welcome' sign. And the backup sign. And my backup badge. Morale is very low.

right.label: Pay for overtime
right.reaction: We'll find the sign. Or a similar sign.

left.label: Blame the next town over
left.reaction: Classic them.

cards.text: There are people outside City Hall with signs. Some of the signs are about you. All of the signs, actually.

right.label: Go out and listen
right.reaction: They yelled. You nodded. Everyone feels slightly better.

left.label: Lock the doors
left.reaction: They're singing now. Badly. On purpose.

cards.text: Business is so bad I've had to sell my third yacht. My second yacht is lonely. Do something.

right.label: Cut business rates
right.reaction: My yachts thank you. Both of them.

left.label: Get a smaller yacht
left.reaction: 'Mayor Mocks Yacht Owner.' I'll be in the papers.

cards.text: The Bugle has a story about you. It's not true. It doesn't need to be. It's in a very big font.

right.label: Give Marge an interview
right.reaction: Lovely. I'll quote you creatively.

left.label: Ignore it
left.reaction: The font got bigger.

cards.text: We are nearly out of money. I've started counting the coins in the fountain. It's mostly buttons.

right.label: Sell the spoon statue
right.reaction: Sold. The town feels emptier. Spoonless.

left.label: Tax hats
left.reaction: Very tall hats pay double.

cards.text: The people love you so much they'd like free ice cream. Every day. They said you'd say yes.

right.label: Free ice cream
right.reaction: They want sprinkles next.

left.label: Say no nicely
left.reaction: They took it badly. One man lay down.

cards.text: Business is so good I'd like to buy the town. Not all of it. Just the parts with roads.

right.label: Sell him Main Street
right.reaction: Welcome to Chad Street. Tolls start Monday.

left.label: Refuse
left.reaction: Everything has a price. I'll wait.

cards.text: With this much support I've started arresting people for jaywalking. And for walking. Thoughts?

right.label: Rein her in
right.reaction: Fine. Walking is legal again.

left.label: Let it ride
left.reaction: The streets have never been emptier.

cards.text: We love you so much we went through your bins. You eat a LOT of string cheese. It's tomorrow's front page.

right.label: Own it
right.reaction: 'Mayor: I Regret Nothing.' Perfect.

left.label: Bury the story
left.reaction: What story? Exactly.

cards.text: Your treasury is bursting. Lend me some? I'll pay it back. With interest. Probably. Possibly.

right.label: Lend it to Chad
right.reaction: A pleasure. I'll send a postcard from the yacht.

left.label: Spend it on the town
left.reaction: A new bench! On every corner! Too many benches!

cards.text: A rival billionaire moved to town. His hat is taller than mine. I need a law about hats. Today.

right.label: Ban tall hats
right.reaction: Justice. My hat is the tallest again.

left.label: Hats are free
left.reaction: He's added a second hat on top of the first hat.

cards.text: The library would like to stay open at night. The best books only talk after dark.

right.label: Fund night opening
right.reaction: Shh. They're starting.

left.label: Libraries close at five
left.reaction: That's what the daytime books want you to think.

cards.text: The fountain is full of coins. People make wishes. Technically, those are our coins.

right.label: Collect the coins
right.reaction: Nobody's wishes are coming true now. Including mine.

left.label: Leave the wishes
left.reaction: Someone wished for a pony. There's a pony now. Who's paying?

cards.text: The town choir only knows one song. It's the bin schedule, set to music. They'd like a second song.

right.label: Fund music lessons
right.reaction: They know two songs now. Both are about bins.

left.label: One song is plenty
left.reaction: They sang it at you. For an hour.

cards.text: Chad's delivery drones keep dropping parcels on the police station. I've received forty hats.

right.label: Ban the drones
right.reaction: The hats stopped. I'm keeping the hats.

left.label: Charge Chad rent for the sky
left.reaction: The sky is a revenue stream now.

cards.text: Someone is stealing pies from windowsills. The crumbs lead to the police station.

right.label: Investigate Barb
right.reaction: Barb confessed. To 'a few'. It was eleven.

left.label: Pie locks for everyone
left.reaction: The thief now steals locks.

cards.text: The only snowplow is broken. School road or Chad's shopping street? The other stays buried.

right.label: Plow the school road
right.reaction: The shops are an igloo now.

left.label: Plow Chad Street
left.reaction: The school is an igloo now.

up.label: Rent a second plow
up.reaction: Two plows. I need to sit down.

cards.text: I want a billboard on City Hall. My face. The words 'TRUST CHAD'. It lights up.

right.label: Allow it
right.reaction: You'll never need a lamp again.

left.label: No billboard
left.reaction: Then where do people look to trust me?

cards.text: Gerald has volunteered to be the school crossing guard. He's already bought the hat. It's a tiny hat.

right.label: Give him the job
right.reaction: Traffic has stopped. All of it. For hours.

left.label: Hire a human
left.reaction: Honk. (He is wearing the hat anyway.)

cards.text: Someone has donated a bench. It's dedicated to 'The Mayor, Who We Tolerate'. It's very comfortable.

right.label: Keep the bench
right.reaction: It's become a tourist spot. People sit and tolerate.

left.label: Change the plaque
left.reaction: It now says 'The Mayor'. Somehow that's worse.

cards.text: The PTA talent show needs a judge. Forty children. One song. It's the same song. It's about you.

right.label: Judge honestly
right.reaction: 'Mayor Makes Children Cry.' Front page.

left.label: Everyone wins
left.reaction: Forty trophies. You're paying for forty trophies.

cards.text: A rival paper has started: The Whistle. Shut it down and The Bugle will adore you.

right.label: Shut it down
right.reaction: One paper. One voice. Mine.

left.label: A free press is good
left.reaction: Read what The Whistle says about your hair.

campaign.text: Election day. The town knows a goose won last time. Run on honesty, or run from it?

right.label: 'At least I'm not a goose'
right.reaction: Gerald heard. Gerald is at the window.

left.label: Promise a recount
left.reaction: Brave. If Gerald wins again we're moving.

up.label: Big rally
up.reaction: We ordered balloons. So many balloons.

campaign.text: Election day. One last push. What's the plan, boss? We believe in you. All three of us.

right.label: Big rally
right.reaction: We ordered balloons. So many balloons.

left.label: Attack ad about the cone
left.reaction: The cone did not respond. Classic cone.

up.label: Kiss every baby in town
up.reaction: Forty babies. One goose. It's fine.

objectives.text: Find out what is in the basement

low:people.title: Run Out by the PTA
low:people.text: Pam read out your record at a meeting. It took four hours. Nobody left. Then everybody came for you, with clipboards.

low:business.title: Bought Out
low:business.text: Chad bought City Hall, the chair you were sitting in, and the chair's opinion of you.

low:law.title: Arrested by Barb
low:law.text: Chief Barb arrested you for general crimes. The judge was Barb. The jury was Barb's helicopter.

low:press.title: Front Page Disgrace
low:press.text: The Bugle printed your face with the word NO under it. Every day. In bigger letters.

low:treasury.title: The Town Is Broke
low:treasury.text: The treasury is one button and a moth. Doug has gone to live in a tree.

high:people.title: Carried Off by Fans
high:people.text: The people love you so much they carried you out of town on their shoulders. They have not put you down.

high:business.title: Acquired
high:business.text: Chad loves you so much he bought you. You are now a subsidiary. Your title is Mayor (Brand Partner).

high:law.title: Made Permanent Deputy
high:law.text: Barb respects you so much she deputised you. For life. You live at the station now. There is a cot.

high:press.title: Turned Into a Column
high:press.text: Marge loves you so much she gave you a column. Then a second. Then you were the paper.

term:won.title: Re-elected
term:won.text: The town has spoken. Mostly in honks. Another week, heaven help everyone.

term:landslide.title: Landslide
term:landslide.text: Sixty per cent or more. The cone has retired. Gerald sent a card. It says HONK, but warmly.

term:lost.title: Voted Out
term:lost.text: The traffic cone will be sworn in at noon. It has promised to do nothing. People found that refreshing.

term:early.title: Recalled for Good
term:early.text: Three recalls. The town has filed you under Never Again. Dave has put the desk in a bin.

cliffhangers: Tomorrow: a pothole with a name.
Tomorrow: a note under your door. Very neat handwriting.
Tomorrow: Timmy has told everyone something.
Tomorrow: the basement. Bring a torch.
Tomorrow: the debate. Your opponent is orange.
